hints.title: Mapped Value Definition
hints.text: Each letter maps to a telephone keypad digit from 1 to 9.

hints.title: Small Length Bound
hints.text: Since n <= 2000, we can iterate over all subarray starting indices i and expand ending index j.

hints.title: Divisibility Check
hints.text: Maintain the running sum of mapped digits. If running_sum % (j - i + 1) == 0, increment the answer.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Double loop running sum accumulation and divisibility checking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining substrings individually with full sum takes O(n^3).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintain running sum during expansion to check divisibility in O(1).
